problem: Block (highest-severity action) prevented far less rupee value per case (~₹437) than Hold (~₹4,387) — the model's ensemble score rewards multi-signal fraud (card-testing, stolen-card) over single-signal high-amount fraud, so the highest-value fraud type wasn't reliably reaching the strongest gate.
fix: Added a deterministic safety-net rule: transactions above the 99th percentile of legit amounts get a minimum Hold action regardless of model score. Explicit, auditable business rule layered on the model.
note_on_heuristic: fraud_type_est is reconstructed post-hoc from device prefix, chargeback flag, and amount ratio, since fraud type wasn't stored as an explicit generator column. Accurate for card_testing/refund_abuse; high_amount vs stolen_card split is approximate.
